claim: bounded parameter-to-DSP approximation inside the sampled Filter Type, Cutoff, and Attack region; not timbre understanding or inverse sound design

filter_type.treatment: categorical one-hot; numeric distance is not assumed

rule.effect: report and model Release, but exclude it from model selection

selection.rule: lowest validation mean normalized MAE across the five predeclared selection targets; ties follow linear then random_forest
selection.final_training_rows: train plus validation after family/config freeze

structured_holdout_diagnostic.label: upper cutoff and attack region
structured_holdout_diagnostic.purpose: bounded diagnostic only; not part of primary model selection

model.format: joblib serialized scikit-learn pipeline; load only from trusted repository evidence

limitations: 256 samples test feasibility, not robust generalization.
Filter Type categories are opaque plugin values rather than semantic filter names.
DSP descriptors do not establish human perceptual quality or timbre understanding.
The structured holdout is a bounded diagnostic, not a broad extrapolation claim.
No inverse search, candidate ranking, or LOCK workflow is implemented.
